problem.title: AI-generated apps are born vulnerable
problem.subtitle: AI writes functional code, but rarely secure code. These are the most common vulnerabilities we find.
problem.card1Desc: Missing Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options and other critical protection headers.
problem.card2Desc: Session cookies without HttpOnly, Secure or SameSite flags properly configured.
problem.card3Desc: Frameworks and libraries with known vulnerabilities (CVEs) left unpatched.
problem.card4Desc: No rate limiting, no honeypots, no automated behavior detection in place.

features.title: Three layers of protection
features.subtitle: From vulnerable to protected with a complete AI-assisted security cycle.
features.scannerDesc: Deterministic scanning without AI — 100% real data, zero hallucinations. Identifies technologies, vulnerabilities and insecure configurations in seconds.
features.advisorDesc: AI interprets scan results, calculates a Security Score, prioritizes risks and offers automatic patches or step-by-step guides tailored to your stack.
features.defenseDesc: Smart honeypots and traps adapted to your technology. Detect, monitor and block attackers automatically in real time.
